item.title: CS 8801 — Designing and Building User Interfaces
item.description:
Graduate Teaching Assistant, Georgia Tech (online), Fall 2024 – Spring 2025.

I served as the instructor of record for this online section, designing the syllabus and curriculum and teaching roughly 100 students through biweekly seminar sessions on designing and building user interfaces.

item.title: CS 1301 — Introduction to Computing
item.description:
Graduate Teaching Assistant, Georgia Tech (online), Summer 2024. Course taught by Prof. David Joyner.

I led test-solution walkthroughs with a team of five TAs and hosted help-desk hours four hours per week to support students in introductory computing.

item.title: CS 8803 — Health Sensing and Interventions
item.description:
Head Graduate Teaching Assistant, Georgia Tech, Spring 2024. Course taught by Prof. Alexander T. Adams.

I co-led a weekly 75-minute lab session with another TA and designed and graded homework for this graduate course on health sensing and interventions.

item.title: CS 1331 — Introduction to Object-Oriented Programming
item.description:
Teaching Assistant, Georgia Tech, Fall 2019 – Spring 2020. Course taught by Prof. Olufisayo Omojokun.

I worked with a team of five TAs to lecture and tutor about 125 students and supported the instructor with course management.
